About this service

This service might be right for you if:

  • You are considering a prenuptial agreement before marriage.
  • You want to consider a postnuptial agreement during marriage.
  • You want to clarify property, debts or other financial responsibilities.
  • You need to coordinate a marital agreement with estate planning.

What we cover

What marital agreements include

Prenuptial agreements
Financial and property arrangements before marriage.
Postnuptial agreements
Agreements about financial matters during marriage.
Property and obligations
Consideration of assets, business interests, debts and inheritances.
Estate planning coordination
Consider how a marital agreement and estate plan interact.
